description: Builds a separately governed local-restricted candidate from a verified City State admission manifest and the exact same operator-managed JSONL.
retry: No automatic retry; correct the rejected local input or semantics map and invoke again.
checkpoint: No checkpoint; exact source replay completes before immutable manifest publication.
idempotency: Source month, source SHA-256 and semantics-map SHA-256 determine the immutable candidate identity; an existing identity is never overwritten.
cancellation: Cancellation before manifest publication removes only this new staging directory and produces no completed candidate.
retention_profile: local-restricted derived metadata and selected ZIP5 rows; no redistribution authorization
